environment.description: Same application deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster. Pod runs with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class via RuntimeClassName: gvisor. The pod spec includes a securityContext with allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true (with emptyDir volumes for /var/uploads and /var/output only), and runAsNonRoot: true (uid 65534). Additionally, a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy is applied that restricts pod egress to only kube-dns on port 53 UDP and the internal object storage endpoint on port 443. The Cilium policy uses a toFQDNs rule matching only 'storage.internal.corp'. A PodSecurityStandard 'restricted' profile is enforced at the namespace level via the built-in admission controller.
